comment: Shared truth table for the mortgage types (docs/specs/mortgage-types.md, table 4.1). Read by backend/src/accounts/mortgage-type.contract.spec.ts and, from P1-F1, by frontend/src/lib/mortgage-type.contract.test.ts, because the two layers cannot import each other and must agree on each type's compounding, method and annualization (INV-LOAN-003, INV-LOAN-007). The numeric rows were derived independently of the implementation, in 50-digit decimal arithmetic with each money figure rounded half away from zero to 4dp: periodicRate per the compounding trait, firstInterest = principal * periodicRate, firstPrincipal per the method (ANNUITY: the level payment P * r(1+r)^N / ((1+r)^N - 1) at 4dp minus firstInterest; LINEAR: P / N; INTEREST_ONLY: 0), effectiveAnnualRate as a percentage at 2dp. The ANNUITY, LINEAR and INTEREST_ONLY rows are spec table 7.5's first payment.
